$comment: Accepted dependency risks for the CI vulnerability scan (scripts/audit-dependencies.mjs). See the 'Dependency Vulnerability Policy' section in SECURITY.md. Suppressions are temporary, must carry a justification, and expire — adding an entry here does NOT silence new advisories.

suppressions.reason: DeepmergeTS stack exhaustion (CWE-674) only triggers on recursive object graphs, which the Prisma CLI never feeds into deepmerge; no patched deepmerge-ts >= 8.0.0 is published and @prisma/config (npm latest) still pins 7.1.5, so no fix is available upstream. Dev/tooling-only exposure — not reachable from the app runtime.
Transitive path of GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx (deepmerge-ts 7.1.5). Same justification: Prisma CLI config merging, dev tooling only, no upstream fix yet.

Transitive dependency of @stellar/stellar-sdk; TOML parsing is only used internally by Stellar SDK for SEP-0001 stellar.toml resolution and not exposed to arbitrary untrusted user inputs in OphirPay runtime.
Transitive dependency of @stellar/stellar-sdk; prototype pollution in toml-node is not reachable through OphirPay endpoints.
Transitive path of toml GHSA-82x6-q7mm-w9cf and GHSA-v5mp-jgw5-2x6j. Fix requires breaking major version bump of @stellar/stellar-sdk which is tracked separately.
